name: ai-rulez
works_with: Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, Codex and 9 more
short: Write your AI rules once and keep every AI tool's config in sync.
what: A tool where you write your AI rules, context, skills and commands once in a `.ai-rulez/` folder, then it writes the right config files for each AI tool you use (CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, Copilot instructions and so on). The skill teaches your agent how to run it.
who: Developers or teams using two or more AI coding tools on the same project who are tired of keeping their instructions in sync. It's overkill if you only use one tool.
needs: Node.js (for npx), or Python with uv, or Homebrew

steps.title: Try it without installing
steps.code: npx ai-rulez@latest init && npx ai-rulez@latest generate

steps.title: Or install it
steps.code:
brew install goldziher/tap/ai-rulez
npm install -g ai-rulez
uv tool install ai-rulez

steps.title: Add the skill to your project
steps.text: Then run `ai-rulez generate` to write it into each tool's skills folder.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text:
ai-rulez add rule my-rule --priority high
ai-rulez generate --dry-run
ai-rulez generate
ai-rulez validate

watch: `generate` writes, and can remove, files across your tools' config folders. Run it with `--dry-run` first on an existing project so it doesn't overwrite a CLAUDE.md you wrote by hand.
Since version 4.22.0, rules go into each tool's own rules folder by default. Set `[rules] mode = "inline"` to keep them in the main files.
Includes and installed skills are fetched from remote git repos when you generate, so only use sources you trust.
